# Vendored UDDF schema

`uddf-3.2.3.xsd` is the machine-readable UDDF 3.2.3 schema mirrored by the `weppos/uddf-specs` project from the published UDDF specification.

- Specification: https://www.streit.cc/resources/UDDF/v3.2.3/en/index.html
- Mirror source: https://github.com/weppos/uddf-specs/blob/main/src/schema/uddf.xsd
- Retrieved: 2026-08-29
- SHA-256 after LF normalization: `6290230322c10209b1021bd800bd90225bdd50fce426baccdb4cce73b38e4ff1`

It is vendored so local builds and CI validate generated UDDF deterministically without depending on a live external URL. The XSD header retains the original authorship and change history.
